```python
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
from griffe.diff import get_breakages

loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load old version at v1.0.0
old = loader.load("mypkg", git_url=".", git_ref="v1.0.0")

# Load new version at HEAD
new = loader.load("mypkg", git_url=".", git_ref="HEAD")

# Iterate over and print breakages
for breakage in get_breakages(old, new):
    print(breakage)
```
